semanticModel.businessPreferences: # METRIC DEFINITIONS # - Franchise Revenue: Total weekly product and service sales per franchisee. Sum aggregation. Primary KPI. # - Lead Conversion Rate: Percentage of incoming leads converted to scheduled in-home consultations within 14 days. Average aggregation. Leading indicator of future revenue. # - Franchise Health Score: Composite 0-100 index combining revenue trajectory (30%), lead conversion (25%), pipeline (20%), invoice completeness (15%), satisfaction (10%). Average aggregation. Scores below 50 = At Risk, below 25 = Inactive. # - Average Project Value: Mean revenue per completed project. Average aggregation. Measures project scope/upsell effectiveness. # - Royalty Yield: Percentage of owed royalties collected on time. Average aggregation. Corporate cash flow indicator. # - Invoice Completeness: Percentage of invoices with full line-item detail. Average aggregation. Proxy for system engagement. # - Active Lead Count: Total leads received per week. Sum aggregation. Measures marketing effectiveness and demand.  # DIMENSION GUIDANCE # - Use "Region" for geographic segmentation (Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, Southwest, West, Mid-Atlantic, Canada) # - Use "Franchise Tier" to compare performance bands (Star, Strong, Developing, At Risk, Inactive) # - Use "Tenure Band" to analyze by franchisee experience (<1 Year, 1-3 Years, 3-7 Years, 7-15 Years, 15+ Years) # - Use "Market Type" for urban/suburban/rural analysis # - Use "Lead Source" for marketing attribution (Web Lead, Referral, Home Show, Repeat Client, Partner/Vendor) # - Use "Product Category" for product mix analysis (Furniture, Window Treatments, Flooring, Lighting & Accessories, Full Room Redesign) # - Use "Coach Name" to evaluate coaching effectiveness  # THRESHOLDS AND TARGETS # - Franchise Revenue: $8,750/week ($35K/quarter) minimum for healthy status # - Lead Conversion Rate: 25% target (top quartile benchmark) # - Franchise Health Score: 65 = healthy threshold; below 50 = At Risk; below 25 = Inactive # - Royalty Yield: 95% collection target # - Invoice Completeness: 95% target # - Average Project Value: $5,000 target  # QUESTION INTENT # - "worst" = steepest percentage-point decline over the trailing 12 weeks # - "best" or "top performing" = highest absolute value in the most recent 4 weeks # - "at risk" = health score below 50 AND declining trajectory # - "coaching candidates" (for coaches TO coach others) = Star tier, 3+ years tenure, health score above 80, improving trend # - "needs coaching" = At Risk or Developing tier with declining health score, prioritized by royalty revenue at stake # - "improving" = positive week-over-week trend sustained for 4+ consecutive weeks # - "declining" = negative trend for 4+ consecutive weeks # - "concentrated" = one segment accounts for >40% of the total decline # - "what happened" or "why" = compare the metric that moved first (lead conversion) to the one that followed (revenue)  # ANSWER STYLE # Lead with the answer, then supporting data. Do not open with questions back to the user. When showing comparisons, always include both the absolute value and the percentage change. When identifying franchisees, include their name, region, tier, and health score.  # TIME CONTEXT # Default comparison: most recent 4 weeks vs. prior 4 weeks. For trend analysis, use trailing 12 weeks. Year-over-year comparisons use same-week-of-year alignment.
